description: FUNCTION NUMVAL-C ACCEPTING an embedded space, and the normalise-in-place edit that follows it. SDTMMI arrives as ' 7' and SDTDDI as '1 '; :305-307 and :309-311 pass each through NUMVAL-C into WS-NUM-99 PIC 99 and move the result BACK INTO THE SAME symbolic-map item, so the screen that is next sent shows '07' and '01'. That in-place rewrite is only possible because 01 CORPT0AO REDEFINES CORPT0AI - the input and output views are one buffer - and it is asserted here on the send rather than inferred. CONFIRMI is spaces, so SUBMIT-JOB-TO-INTRDR's guard at :464 fires and :465-470 STRINGs 'Please confirm to print the ' DELIMITED BY SIZE, WS-REPORT-NAME DELIMITED BY SPACE and ' report...' DELIMITED BY SIZE - which is where the ten-byte WS-REPORT-NAME contributes only its six significant characters. Nothing is handed to the queue: the emit loop at :498-508 is entered with ERR-FLG-ON and its body runs zero times. Expected values are STATICALLY DERIVED by reading app/cbl/CORPT00C.cbl, its copybooks, app/bms/CORPT00.bms and app/csd/CARDDEMO.CSD - never captured from a COBOL run, which is impossible in this environment (risk R-A). Java has no transient data queue, so EXEC CICS WRITEQ TD QUEUE('JOBS') at :517 is reproduced through an explicit job-submission port; the eighty-byte content is identical and the dataset key JOBS names the TDQUEUE(JOBS) that app/csd/CARDDEMO.CSD:499-505 defines as RECORDSIZE(80) RECORDFORMAT(FIXED) BLOCKFORMAT(UNBLOCKED) DISPOSITION(MOD).
